rationale: When step 7 of 10 fails due to an unexpected exception or hazardous execution during untrusted code detonation, resuming is dangerous because the guest memory and local state are corrupted, while starting fresh incurs a full cold boot and dependency reinstall cost. Rolling back to the step 6 snapshot restores verified clean CPU, memory, and disk state within 120ms without risking dirty state propagation or wasting token and boot budget.
